batch: Classify and enumerate the complete Stübe 1895 scan
policy: Scope and enumeration follow the inspected primary edition. Exact VA numbers attach source appearances to existing Berlin catalogue records; unnamed items remain separate candidates.

entries.basis: The complete volume catalogues nineteen numbered Berlin items on printed pp. 13-18 and provides a transcription, translation, comparison, and commentary for VA 2416 beginning on printed p. 22.
